title: IntakeGuard Inspection Report
description: Result of processing one input under one policy. Consumers MUST treat verdict=error exactly like verdict=rejected.

reportVersion.description: 0.2 adds policyDecision and original.complete (both optional, additive).

policyDecision.description: What the policy decided before any transformation. Lets an inspect-only caller see 'transform' while verdict stays rejected because no output artifact exists. verdict is still the only field consumers may act on.

policyDigest.description: sha256 of the canonicalized effective policy (defaults applied).

verdict.description: accepted: passed checks, no transformation, the original may be used. transformed: passed checks, and ONLY output may be used. rejected: do not use. error: processing failed; treat as rejected.

reasonCodes.description: Codes registered in spec/reasons.yaml. Empty only when verdict is accepted or transformed with no warnings.

checks.description: Every check the engine knows about for this format, with its outcome. 'skipped' never counts as a pass.

sha256.description: Hash of the bytes the engine read. If complete is false, this covers only the prefix read before a limit stopped reading.

complete.description: False when a stream limit stopped reading before end of input. Absent means true (report 0.1).

output.description: Present if and only if verdict is transformed. output.sha256 MUST differ from original.sha256.

nonGuarantees.description: Short notes on what this verdict does not establish, e.g. 'not scanned for malware'.
